name: bitrouter
description: Route model calls through BitRouter and delegate long-running, parallel workflows to BRO Goals with ACP-compatible harnesses. Built-in Goal workers use retained native Thread/Turn execution with one-time permission replies; the skill documents bounded model-admission waiting and remaining recovery/budget-wait limits. The bro and bro code interfaces show Goals, current-Goal input and a read-only Workflow. Native harness launchers, headless run, native BRO ACP v1/v2 and transparent external acp serve and separately privileged native task APIs remain available. Bundles the BitRouter setup and operations skill. Finished scoped local work has evidence-gated recovery; unresolved effects remain blocked. Tasks can select acknowledged BRO model routes, configured MCP and versioned skill/context material; supplied configuration does not prove actual use. Current-Goal resource edits are versioned and reach replacement execution after old-work reconciliation. Unresolved Goal inputs persist across queries; exact input references and reasoned dispositions preserve scope. Exact input withdrawal remains available without a model; Goal IPC v5 does not replay older outboxes.
